# Water Systems Bench

> A practical workflow hub for sizing, checking, troubleshooting and planning real-world water systems from source to use.

## Current implemented cluster

- [Pumps, Pressure & Pipe Flow](https://watersystemsbench.com/systems/pumps-pressure-pipe/)

## Tools

- [Total Dynamic Head Calculator](https://watersystemsbench.com/tools/total-dynamic-head-calculator/)
- [Pipe Friction Loss Calculator](https://watersystemsbench.com/tools/pipe-friction-loss-calculator/)
- [Water Pipe Size & Velocity Checker](https://watersystemsbench.com/tools/water-pipe-size-velocity-checker/)
- [Pump Power & Efficiency Calculator](https://watersystemsbench.com/tools/pump-power-efficiency-calculator/)
- [Booster Pump Duty Point Estimator](https://watersystemsbench.com/tools/booster-pump-duty-point-estimator/)
- [Pump Curve Duty Point Comparator](https://watersystemsbench.com/tools/pump-curve-duty-point-comparator/)
- [NPSH Available Calculator](https://watersystemsbench.com/tools/npsh-available-calculator/)
- [Pump Operating Cost Comparator](https://watersystemsbench.com/tools/pump-operating-cost-comparator/)
- [Low Water Pressure Troubleshooter](https://watersystemsbench.com/tools/low-water-pressure-troubleshooter/)

## Safety and limitations

The site supports preliminary planning. Outputs are not formal engineering approval, legal advice, manufacturer selection, or a universal regulatory determination. Verify measurements, applicable requirements and current manufacturer data.
